_comment: Adapter: Frozen Electrocuted Combustion 6.1.3 (powerofthree). Not a perk mod - FEC picks the
death effect of an actor killed by magic from keywords on the killing effect, and reads them
the way the perk mods do (github.com/powerof3/FEC: src/Papyrus.cpp GetCauseOfDeath,
Scripts/Source fec_deatheffectsnpctemp.psc). Its gate: the effect is hostile and detrimental
Fire, frost and shock are the vanilla keywords, which vanilla.json already adds; this file
carries the two FEC reads that no other file gives:
PO3_MagicDamageSun - sun death (burst into flames, disintegrate). FEC.esp defines it, and
FEC's own DLL adds it only to effects that use the vanilla Dawnguard sun visuals, so sun
spells from other mods get no sun death without this line
MagicDamageWind - air death (suffocation; FEC's temporary-effect path). FEC compares the
editor id as text and does not define the keyword: it comes with spell mods (Mihail's
High Fantasy Pack, Elemental Destruction Magic Redux). Where no plugin defines it the line
rests, like any line whose keyword is not in the load order
holy - FEC has no holy death; sun's fire-and-ash look is not what holy damage reads as
drain, poison, fear - FEC reads these from the archetype and resist value, not keywords

adapters.why: air damage: FEC air death. Not on spells that are also fire, frost or shock (FEC reads those first)
